title: Burgerlijk Wetboek 7:655 and 7:652: de opgave van de arbeidsvoorwaarden
source: Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 7, arts. 7:652 and 7:655, version in force from 8 October 2026 (arts. 7:652 and 7:655 read as in the version from 1 July 2026) (wetten.overheid.nl BWBR0005290). Read 2026-10-09.
note: A drafting check, not legal advice: the scripted rules read whether a particular is there, never whether a term is lawful.

rules.text: Items a to e, h, i and q within a week of the start, the rest within a month; work abroad before departure.
The parties with their homes, the place of work, the function, the start and a fixed term's end or length.

Whether the worker joins a pension scheme, whether it is an agency or payroll contract (and the user), whether it is for an indefinite time and whether an on-call contract: answered, never marked not applicable.
rules.source: 7:655 lid 1 j, m, n, o, p

rules.text: The pay with its starting amount, its elements, and how and how often it is paid.
Holidays and other paid leave, the termination procedure, the hours (or the variable schedule's guaranteed hours, days and notice), the cao, training and the social security institutions.
rules.source: 7:655 lid 1 f, g, i, l, r, s

rules.text: A probation of at most two months; one month in a fixed term under two years or with no calendar end, unless a collective agreement sets a longer one; none in a contract of six months or less.
Only items f to i, k and q to s may point to a cao; the rest are stated.
Work outside the Netherlands over four consecutive weeks: the country and length, the housing, the social insurance, the currency, the allowances and the return.
